newsitem.title: UK: IMI buoyed by upgrade, positive comment.
newsitem.headline: IMI buoyed by upgrade, positive comment.

text.p: Shares in engineering group IMI Plc extended gains on Friday as analysts raised earnings forecasts and repeated "buy" advice following news of the group's acquisition of TA Hydronics on Thursday.
The shares were trading 14p better at 401p by 1055 GMT after adding 10p on Thursday.
Harry Philips, industry analyst at Panmure Gordon, repeated his "buy" recommendation on the stock and gave the shares a 450p price target.

"We've been positive on the stock for a while, but yesterday's news drew attention to the fairly dramatic progress the company has made in the last 18 months on the upgrading of the quality of the portfolio," Philips said.
IMI agreed to acquire TA Hydronics from Sweden's Incentive AB group for 97 million stg. TA produces balancing valves, radiator and shut-off valves and components used in hydronic systems.
"The shares are trading at a 15 percent discount to the market and for a stock with that momentum and strong global market position we feel it is too low," said Philips.

The analyst raised his current year forecast by two million stg to 158 million stg, giving 29.7p earnings per share. Philips added five million stg to bring next year's earnings forecast up to 178 million stg.
Traders said Merrill Lynch was also positive on the stock on Friday but the analysts were not immediately available to comment.
